name: adaca-analytics
description: Open-source Google Analytics 4 / BigQuery dashboards on Cloudflare Workers — daily rollups in D1, customisable widget dashboards.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json

DB.description: D1 database holding sites, dashboards and the daily analytics rollups.

CACHE.description: KV namespace caching Google access tokens and live realtime reports.

GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON.description: Contents of a Google Cloud service-account JSON key with Viewer access on your GA4 property (and BigQuery read roles if you use the export).

BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME.description: Optional. Set together with BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD to put the app behind HTTP Basic Auth. Leave empty to protect it with Cloudflare Access instead.

BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD.description: Optional. Password for the Basic Auth gate.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Optional. A Resend API key, so weekly/monthly summaries and traffic alerts can be emailed. Slack webhooks need no key.

REPORT_FROM.description: Optional. The sender address for emailed reports, on a domain verified in Resend (e.g. analytics@yourcompany.com).
